one_liner: Pylon (usepylon.com) is a B2B support platform with a REST API using admin-created bearer tokens, plus an official OAuth MCP server, but the API is bundled into paid seat plans.
auth_notes: The REST API uses a bearer API token that an Admin creates in Settings. Tokens don't expire and have no scopes; the role controls access. The tenant is in the US or EU region. OAuth 2.0 exists only for the MCP server, not as a documented third-party OAuth flow for the REST API.
access_notes: The pricing page lists REST API and scoped tokens under paid plans (Professional $89 per seat/month on an annual contract). No free tier or trial is evidenced. Only Admins can create tokens.
blocker_notes: A paid Pylon seat subscription and an Admin user are needed to get an API token. Each customer must create and paste their own token, and the region must match. The sandbox is Enterprise-only.

evidence.quote: The Pylon API uses [Bearer](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750#section-2.1) authentication. This means you’ll need to pass your API token in the header of your request
Tokens don't expire, and their access is controlled only by the role. There are no separate scopes.
Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.
